task: EPMCDME-14584 — restore the OAuth connect-with-test flow for saved folded OAuth integrations (Jira/Confluence/GitLab) so a masked stored client_secret is validated via connect-with-test instead of being sent to /initiate.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.affected: constants/integration.ts (isFoldedOAuth/resolveOAuthVariant helpers), OAuthTestAction, EditProjectIntegrationPage, EditUserIntegrationPage, SettingsForm, userSettings store (3 connect*OAuth methods)
component_scope.layers: UI (pages, components, form), State (Valtio store), shared constants module

requirements_clarity.label: S
requirements_clarity.gaps: Well-scoped bug fix against a specific ticket; the folded-OAuth model and connect-with-test contract were already established by the 14586/14587 refactor. Only minor confirmation around masked-secret routing behavior.

technical_risk.label: L
technical_risk.risk_factors: Handles OAuth authentication credentials — routes a masked/stored client_secret through connect-with-test; incorrect routing sends the mask to /initiate and breaks the test, or risks persisting a token where none should be persisted.
technical_risk.mitigation: Reuses the existing connect-with-test path (server decrypts by setting_id, no token persisted); guarded by the isFoldedOAuth marker + settingId + MASKED_VALUE check; covered by unit tests on the helpers, OAuthTestAction, and store methods.

key_reasoning.reason: Six source components touched across the UI and state layers — two Edit pages, OAuthTestAction, SettingsForm, the userSettings store, plus new helpers in the shared constants/integration.ts module consumed across integration forms.

Sits directly on the OAuth authentication path — decides whether a masked stored client_secret is validated server-side via connect-with-test or (wrongly) sent to /initiate; a mistake either breaks the test or mishandles credentials.
9 files changed (311 insertions, 43 deletions) spanning three top-level src areas (constants, pages, store), including three test files — squarely in the L band (8–10 files).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): change affects authentication/authorization — routes a masked/stored client_secret through the OAuth connect-with-test flow.
Component Scope bumped from M (3) to L (4): adds isFoldedOAuth/resolveOAuthVariant helpers to the shared constants/integration.ts module used across the integration forms.
